rv.q: Director and Jeff Award nominee, Jeffrey Cass, has brought Brooks’ vision to life in the way it was meant to be seen.
BrightSide’s production is polished so brightly it sparkles and shines like Times Square.
"The Producers" soars as it skewers stereotypes and makes fun of everything and everyone in a riotous revival at the BrightSide Theatre in Naperville, Illinois.
Brightside’s production features a stellar cast performing this laugh-out-loud, raucous show.

cn.t: Critics lavish praise on this production of Mel Brooks' musical comedy classic, with reviewers highlighting uproarious laughter and hilarious performances that do justice to the Tony-winning material.
